population_one_line: Retrospective lab analysis of 158,710 blood culture bottles (Barnes-Jewish Hospital) using BacT/Alert Virtuo system
ttp_reported: median TTP 16.5h (50%); mean 21.1h; species-specific medians (S. aureus 15.6h, E. coli 9.5h, Candida 42.9h)
outcome_one_line: No patient-level clinical outcomes analyzed; chart review limited to >4d positive bottles for 'clinical impact' categorization (qualitative)
notes: Methods paper assessing optimal incubation time; descriptive TTP distributions only, no TTP-outcome quantitative analysis

population_one_line: Adults with P. aeruginosa bloodstream infection, single center Madrid, 2013-2017
ttp_reported: TTP analyzed as continuous variable (per-hour) in multivariate model
outcome_one_line: Shorter TTP associated with 5-day mortality: aOR 0.88 (95% CI 0.80-0.97), p=0.010; also significant for 30-day mortality
notes: Per-hour TTP coefficient with CI in adjusted logistic regression for both 5-day and 30-day mortality

population_one_line: Adult ICU patients with suspected catheter-related BSI (60-bed medical-surgical ICU, university hospital, Belgium)
ttp_reported: DTTP (differential TTP) median 2.1h CR-BSI vs 3.3h non-CR-BSI
outcome_one_line: DTTP used for diagnosis of CR-BSI; no clinical outcomes (mortality/persistence) analyzed in relation to TTP
notes: Diagnostic accuracy study for DTTP→CR-BSI diagnosis only; only n=3 CR-BSI; no mortality/clinical failure analysis

population_one_line: Hospitalized people who inject drugs (PWID) with GAS BSI, Temple University Hospital 2022-2024
ttp_reported: Mean days of positive blood cultures 1.2 monomicrobial vs 2.6 polymicrobial (descriptive only)
outcome_one_line: Length of stay 7 vs 15 days; 8% recurrent BSI; no mortalities; no quantitative TTP-outcome association
notes: Conference abstract (poster) only; descriptive results, no TTP-outcome quantitative analysis

population_one_line: Hemodialysis patients with tunneled cuffed catheters, Madrid 2006-2008
ttp_reported: TTP cutoff ≤14h evaluated for predicting S. epidermidis CRBSI (sens 52.1%, spec 97.7%); DTTP >2h used for CRBSI confirmation
outcome_one_line: TTP used as diagnostic marker for CRBSI prediction; no patient died of CRBSI; no TTP→mortality/clinical failure analysis
notes: TTP analyzed as a diagnostic predictor of subsequent CRBSI episodes, not as predictor of clinical outcome in BSI patients

population_one_line: Adult S. aureus bacteremia patients, Detroit Receiving Hospital 2006
ttp_reported: Mean TTP 27.03h transient SAB (n=35) vs 18.42h persistent SAB (n=77), p=0.014, 95% CI 1.85-15.38
outcome_one_line: Longer TTP significantly associated with transient (vs persistent) bacteremia; similar mortality, readmission, relapse rates between groups
notes: TTP↔persistent bacteremia (microbiological clearance) quantitative comparison; mortality TTP comparison not formally reported but compares TTP between persistence groups

population_one_line: Adult inpatients with blood cultures, tertiary medical center Basel 2020
ttp_reported: TTP analyzed as outcome of pre-analytical factors (filling volume) via linear mixed models
outcome_one_line: TTP is the dependent variable predicted by pre-analytical factors; no TTP→clinical outcome analysis
notes: Pre-analytical methods paper; TTP treated as outcome, not predictor of clinical outcomes

population_one_line: Hematology/oncology patients with CVCs undergoing chemotherapy, Hannover Medical School 2004-2006
ttp_reported: Differential TTP ≥2h used only as diagnostic criterion for CR-BSI confirmation
outcome_one_line: Primary outcome CR-BSI rate (chlorhexidine vs standard dressing); no TTP→clinical outcome analysis
notes: RCT of dressings; TTP used only as diagnostic tool, no TTP-outcome quantitative analysis

population_one_line: Adult ICU patients with suspected catheter-related BSI, 16-bed ICU Spain 2007-2009
ttp_reported: DTP ≥120 min used for CR-BSI diagnosis to enable catheter retention; not analyzed as predictor of outcome
outcome_one_line: Primary outcome: reduction in catheter removals (32% DTP vs 100% standard); no TTP→clinical outcome quantitative association
notes: RCT of DTP-guided catheter management strategy; TTP is the diagnostic tool, not the exposure for clinical outcome

population_one_line: Candidemia patients (mixed ages including some pediatric), tertiary hospital Kerala India 2017-2021
ttp_reported: Median TTP 34h (IQR 21.75-50); TTP dichotomized at 24h; species-specific medians reported
outcome_one_line: TTP ≤24h: 30.2% survivors vs 40.5% died (p=0.3); Kaplan-Meier survival by TTP using log-rank test (no significant survival difference)
notes: Categorical TTP↔mortality analysis with chi-square and Kaplan-Meier/log-rank; null association reported. Mixed-age cohort includes some pediatric patients (flag per protocol)
